content.title: Trump's China Trip: AI Progress Uncertain
content.caption: President Trump's visit to China on AI progress is uncertain due to internal disagreements and past scandals.

slides.heading: Trump's China Trip: AI Progress Uncertain
slides.text: President Trump's visit to China on AI progress is uncertain due to internal disagreements and past scandals.

slides.heading: Internal Disagreements
slides.text: Administration officials privately tell Inner Loop they see little room for progress in alleviating AI safety and espionage concerns.

slides.heading: Past Scandals
slides.text: The fallout from former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with Alice Huang, an executive at Megaspeed and suspected Chinese intelligence asset, has made any negotiations around AI development fraught for the world's two largest economies.
